text:
olivia: FYI customer ACME (acct: acme-inc) opened a ticket — tool calls to price_lookup are returning 400 invalid_args in prod since ~09:10 UTC. They say it used to work.
raj: can you paste the error payload + request id? we'll triage.
olivia: request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Error from inference gateway: `400 Bad Request: schema_validation_failed: missing required field 'currency'` — but their client never sent a currency before and defaulting to USD used to work.
ben: :eyes: which model/runtime? any recent deploys?
support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2025-1647 — linked ticket https://support.redwood.ai/t/INC-2025-1647
olivia: Hosted inference; runtime image inference-core:v2.3.1 rolled out 03:00 UTC today.
raj: that aligns with the timing. CI/evals might have caught this — do we have failing golden tests?
qa-jen: I see a CI failure on the toolcall golden suite: job `e2e-toolcall-golden/1378` failed on main -> https://ci.redwood.ai/build/1378. Failing test name: `price_lookup_schema_compatibility` — stack:
```
AssertionError: expected response to accept missing 'currency' key
ValidationError: field 'currency' is required
```
ben: repro steps from prod-like client:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDSHOT" \
  -d '{"tool": "price_lookup", "args": {"item_id": "SKU-123"}}'
```
returns the 400 above.
olivia: customer says they started seeing billing spikes correlated with retries after failures — their client retries on non-2xx which increased token usage.
raj: billing impact + regression = high priority. My hunch: the new validation lib (jsonschemavalidator v1.8.0) tightened optional/null behavior and now treats currency as required because the tool schema was implicitly allowing null before.
ben: quick check in prod logs shows `schema_matcher` module logged: `required_missing: currency` around the same request ids.
qa-jen: confirmed in CI: the golden prompt that previously exercised the fallback path now triggers the stricter validation. Repro in local container when running inference-core:v2.3.1. v2.3.0 accepts the request.
raj: immediate mitigation options:
- rollback inference-core to v2.3.0 for Hosted (and create hotfix image v2.3.2 to relax validation)
- add router-level compatibility layer to fill `currency: "USD"` when missing for price_lookup
- ask customers to add currency in calls (not ideal)
olivia: customer will accept a temporary router workaround; ask ops if rollback will be faster.
deploy-bot: Deploy candidate check: rollback-hosted-inference -> safe to deploy in 2 zones. CI gating: none for emergency rollback.
ben: router patch is small, ~12 LOC. But rollout might take ~30-45m to reach all regions. Rollback is ~15m.
raj: rollbacks also affect Dedicated customers if image is shared; better to do router shim first for Hosted and schedule image rollback on a maintenance window. We'll prioritize router shim + hotfix.
qa-jen: I'll add a regression test to the golden suite to cover missing optional fields for tool schemas and pin it in CI. Creating ticket RD-5731.
olivia: I'll message ACME with a temp workaround and ETA. "We've identified the cause in a runtime validator change and will deploy a compatibility fix within the hour; in the meantime please include `currency: \"USD\"` in requests or we can apply a server-side shim."
raj: action items:
- raj: open emergency PR for router shim -> #PR-9881 (linked)
- ben: prepare v2.3.2 hotfix relaxing the validator logic, run canary -> #PR-9882
- qa-jen: add RD-5731 to golden suite and run failing-case locally
- olivia: send customer update + collect any extra request ids

olivia: PR links posted when available. thanks all :heart:

ben: leaving notes for postmortem: ensure we have a pre-release compatibility test for schema validator upgrades; include a checklist for major validator bumps.

qa-jen: adding to postmortem template. Also recommend we add a CI gate that runs the existing golden prompt set against the new validator binary before rollout.

support-bot: Escalation status: IN_PROGRESS. Assigned: raj, ben, qa-jen. Priority: P1.

olivia: updated ticket and CC'd customer success. I'll close the loop once shim is live.

raj: shim merged and deployed to Hosted canary at 09:28 UTC. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment succeeded in eu-west-1. Rollout to remaining Hosted zones starting.

ben: shim is live everywhere at 09:41 UTC. Verified ACME request now returns 200 and no extra retries. Marking mitigation complete.

olivia: customer confirmed success and billing spike trend reversed. Filing follow-up to schedule v2.3.2 rollout and longer-term fix.

qa-jen: CI golden job 1378 re-run against v2.3.2 candidate shows pass after adding fallback test. Creating RFC for validator upgrade process.

olivia: closing the incident in support tracker; will attach postmortem draft shortly. :shipit:
